'''Borik Yelgo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Borik Yelgo was [[Jedi training/Legends|instructed]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] until achieving the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] upon the completion of his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Serving the Order throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a bloody conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jedi Yelgo was able to survive the war and the traitorous betrayal of the Order by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Palpatine, indeed the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], ordering them to slay their Jedi allies. While Yelgo's role in the war remains ambiguous, he was able to avoid slaughter by the minions of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and escape into hiding as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] reorganized the ruins of the Republic and disbanded the Jedi Order.<ref name="ICF" />

Added to a list of fugitives wanted by the Empire, Yelgo was tracked down by Imperial agents to the [[Coth Fuuras space station]]. Assigned to kill Yelgo was [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] [[Squad 40]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]; the three clones devised a plan to limit civilian casualties on the station by setting off a fire alarm that would necessitate the evacuation of the station. As the throng of civilians passed beyond a disguised checkpoint, the squad caught sight of Yelgo, distinctive for his broken nose and freckles. As the [[Mission to Coth Fuuras space station|ambush]] unfolded, Yelgo attempted to escape but was not fast enough to make it through the fire doors before they shut. Trapped, Yelgo was resigned to die fighting and drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and engaged the squad. Deflecting blaster bolts, Yelgo concentrated on a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] wall and used the Force to bring it down upon himself and the squad. Before he was able to shatter the wall completely, Yelgo was caught off guard by commando [[Rede]], who blasted through the wall and caused it to shatter prematurely. As the wall exploded over Yelgo's head, Rede raced in and stabbed him in the gut. Stunned, Yelgo collapsed to his knees where Rede shot him twice in the head.<ref name="ICF" />
